# PromptPerfect

> Open-source prompt optimization tool that automatically improves your LLM prompts and explains the changes. Providers: Google Gemini (default), OpenAI (incl. GPT-6 Astra with reasoning effort), Anthropic. Keys via server env or per-request BYOK (never persisted).

## Documentation

- [Try PromptPerfect](https://promptperfect-beaglecorp.vercel.app): Use it in your browser — no install needed
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Beagle-AI-automation/promptperfect): Source code, setup instructions, contributing guide
- [API Routes](https://github.com/Beagle-AI-automation/promptperfect#api): POST /api/optimize (streaming) and POST /api/optimize-sync (JSON, CORS allowlisted, extension-compatible) endpoint docs

## Optimization Modes

- Better: General-purpose prompt improvement with explanations
- Specific: Adds constraints, types, edge cases for technical prompts
- Chain-of-Thought: Restructures prompts for step-by-step reasoning
- Developer / Research / Beginner / Product / Marketing: Domain-tuned rewrites
- Production Audit: Link a project directory (analyzed locally in the browser) and get the integral master prompt for production readiness

## Features

- Template Library: 60 production-ready prompt templates across 60 categories, forkable into the optimizer with one click; works offline
- Prompt Library: Save, search, filter, re-optimize and share prompts (Supabase backend or localStorage fallback)
- Result enrichments: heuristic quality score + checklist, {{PLACEHOLDER}} guard, token/cost estimates, Markdown download
- Guest quota (5 free, configurable) with local-dev unlimited mode; Supabase Auth (email + Google OAuth)

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 16 (App Router)
- Vercel AI SDK (streaming + generateText)
- Tailwind CSS 4
- Supabase (auth, history, library, analytics)
- TypeScript (strict), Vitest, ESLint
